appearance.note: index.html sets data-theme before first paint; the header ThemeToggle flips and saves it.

legacyAliases.note: Kept only so older screens resolve. Not part of the system; do not use in new code.

display.purpose: The single big figure on a data screen (Tracker calories left). Not a page title.

title.purpose: Picks shelf heading and hall card names on Today.

title-sm.purpose: Station names above their cards, sheet titles, empty-state titles.

body.purpose: Running text and sheet descriptions; reading width near 42rem.

dish-name.purpose: The name in every dish row (600 on pick tiles and ranking options).

subhead.purpose: Status lines, counts, chips, small buttons, link actions (400 or 600).

label.purpose: Second line under a dish, tile station names, nutrition labels, tab bar labels.

score-numeral.purpose: Only inside score rings and score-range pills; 0.8125rem to 2.75rem by ring size, tabular, 700.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift for cards, tiles, sheets, menus and the active hall pill in light mode; dark mode raises by tone instead.

shadows.name: material-bar
shadows.value: background: rgb(15 15 16 / 0.86) dark, rgb(244 244 245 / 0.86) light; backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px)
shadows.purpose: Header and tab bar only; solid ground under prefers-reduced-transparency.

motion.name: ease-apple
motion.purpose: All state transitions; buttons 200ms, rows and chips 150ms, fades 220ms.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Sheets settling (420ms) and ranking steps (320ms); about 2% overshoot.

motion.name: ease-spring-lively
motion.purpose: The one celebratory moment: a ranking score landing (560ms).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons, pick tiles and ranking options on press.

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview:
NU Dining sits on the same shelf as Resy and Beli: a near-black app by default, warm off-white type, and food presented as tappable things rather than as a document. Every menu is the same three moves: a swipeable shelf of picks, each station as one grouped card of rows, and every dish opening the same bottom sheet. Scores live in Beli-style rings whose number always carries the meaning; the ring's tint only echoes it.

Density is app-like, not editorial. Rows are 56px tall with a quiet second line, cards are 18px-rounded with hairline dividers between rows, and the type never climbs above 48px. One coral-red accent marks what you can act on and where you are. Everything else is neutral greys with a faint warm cast in dark mode and a cool cast in light mode.

Dark is the default appearance; light is a remembered choice. The world was built to replace an editorial "poster" world (red plate, run-in text, heavy 800 weights, giant billing type), and those devices are rejected here.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default (#0F0F10 ground, #1A1A1C cards); light on request, saved under `nu-dining:theme` and applied before first paint.
Grouped station cards: 18px radius, hairline row dividers, rows that open a sheet.
A horizontally swiping picks shelf whose next tile always peeks.
One bottom sheet per dish, the same anatomy everywhere.
Score rings tinted by tier, number always visible, 700 weight only there.
One coral-red accent for actions, the active tab and links.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Coral red means "act here" or "you are here": a primary button, the active tab, a link. It never fills a card, a header or a section ground.

rules.name: The Number Carries It Rule
rules.body: Score tint, status colour and tier colour always sit on a number or a word that says the same thing. Colour alone never carries meaning.

rules.name: The 600 Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Text tops out at 600. 700 is reserved for score numerals; nothing anywhere is heavier.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Rule
rules.body: Calories, counts, dates, scores and nutrition use tabular figures so columns of numbers hold still.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: In dark mode a surface is raised by stepping `bg` to `surface` to `surface-2`, never by adding a shadow.

dos: **Do** default to dark and read every colour through its role token so the light appearance follows automatically.
**Do** put a station's dishes in one 18px card with hairline row dividers, and let every row open the dish sheet.
**Do** show the number inside every score ring, tinted by tier at 6.8 and 3.4.
**Do** keep coral red to primary buttons, the active tab indicator, links and the focus ring.
**Do** write status as words ("Open until 10 PM"), tinted `open`, `warn` or `ink-subtle`.
**Do** keep every tap target at least 44px and every pill fully rounded.
**Do** use `cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)` for state changes and the springs only for sheets settling and a score landing; respect reduced motion and reduced transparency.
donts: **Don't** use weights above 600 for text; 700 is only for score numerals, and 800 or 900 never.
**Don't** fill a card, section or header with coral red, or use it as a status colour.
**Don't** make "New" a filled badge, pill or coloured tag.
**Don't** let colour alone carry a score, status or selection; pair it with the number, the word or `aria-pressed`/`aria-current`.
**Don't** bring back the poster devices this world replaced: run-in text, billing-sized type (the unused `headliner` and `support` sizes), or caps-and-tracking labels.
**Don't** add shadows in dark mode; raise with a tone step instead.
**Don't** use `plate*` or `g1` to `g9` in new code; they are legacy aliases.
